title: Causality, Influence, and Computation in Possibly Disconnected Dynamic Networks
review_status: full-text audit complete; adversarial synchronous model, temporal influence/coverage assumptions, termination conditions, counting/gossip protocols, and optimality scope checked
venue_year_verified: Journal of Parallel and Distributed Computing, 2014; DOI verified
evidence_note: Formal protocols work under bounded-window temporal influence/coverage conditions even if each instantaneous graph may be disconnected; worst-case model, not trace-driven mobile-network evaluation.

title: DART-MPI: An MPI-based Implementation of a PGAS Runtime System
review_status: full-text audit complete; DART-MPI design, Cray XE6 setup, blocking/nonblocking primitive measurements, native-MPI baselines, and platform/task limitations checked
sections_checked: latency overhead results and message-size transition
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 2015; venue not independently verified
evidence_note: Measured overheads around 80–130 ns for tested operation classes on a Cray XE6; primitive-level result, not broad modern application speedup.

title: TrueChain: Highly Performant Decentralized Public Ledger
review_status: full-text audit complete; initial Minerva design, hybrid-consensus/security claims, sharding/speculative-execution proposal, beta-net throughput statement, and reporting limitations checked
sections_checked: public gossip versus private committee-gossip throughput reports
evidence_note: Paper contrasts about 80 TPS with public PoW gossip against >2,000 TPS in beta-net deployment using private committee gossip (gsize < csize/6); no matched workload/latency/reproducibility details to infer a causal >25x gain, and it discusses throughput-security/eclipsing tradeoffs.

title: GHAST: Breaking Confirmation Delay Barrier in Nakamoto Consensus via Adaptive Weighted Blocks
review_status: full-text audit complete; tree-graph/weight adaptation, latency/adversary assumptions, confidence bound, and no-observable-attack comparison checked
venue_year_verified: arXiv v1 2020; no venue independently verified
evidence_note: Theorem gives O(d log(1/epsilon)) confirmation for adversary power bounded away from 50% under model assumptions; 3d vs roughly 360d is a no-observable-attack equal-confidence comparison, not live deployment measurement.

title: Reaching Consensus for Asynchronous Distributed Key Generation
review_status: full-text audit complete; Byzantine threshold, expected rounds/communication, PKI assumption, component protocols, and theoretical-versus-operational interpretation checked
evidence_note: Protocol tolerates f<n/3, uses constant expected rounds and Õ(n^3) expected communication under PKI; asymptotic protocol result, not a wall-clock service-level guarantee.

title: Revisiting Lower Bounds for Two-Step Consensus
review_status: full-text audit complete; classical-bound scope, practical fast-decision definition, partially synchronous crash model, task/object distinction, and matching bounds checked
sections_checked: Lamport lower bound and apparent counterexample
tight task/object theorems and crash assumptions
evidence_note: Changing which processes/scenarios must decide within two message delays changes tight threshold; task bound max(2e+f,2f+1), object bound max(2e+f−1,2f+1), under partially synchronous crash model.

title: Unleashing the Power of Tree-of-Thoughts for Edge-Enabled AIGC Service Provisioning
review_status: full-text audit complete; Qwen 2.5-7B creative-writing characterization, DAG placement objective, DSAC simulation baselines, reported maxima, and deployment/generalization limits checked

evidence_note: Reports maximum simulation delay gains 8.32% vs PPO, 11.57% vs SAC, 36.09% vs DDQN and >80% vs local generation; Qwen creative-writing case, not live edge deployment.
